items.title: VISTA Architect: A graph database-oriented health AI system demonstrated in multidisciplinary tumor boards
items.title_zh: VISTA Architect：面向图数据库的健康AI系统及其在多学科肿瘤委员会中的演示
items.summary: VISTA Architect turns longitudinal EHR documentation into a provenance-linked knowledge graph and a deduplicated clinical timeline so downstream LLM queries avoid reprocessing raw text; at Stanford Medicine tumor boards it reached 96.4% accuracy on 15 salient variables across 1,180 patients, and an agentic interface cut preparation for a 30-patient cohort to about 2.2 minutes.

items.title: Trust-Aware Multi-Agent Traceability: Confidence-Calibrated Knowledge Graphs for Consistent Software Artifact Management
items.title_zh: 可信多 Agent 可追溯性：面向一致软件制品管理的置信度校准知识图谱
items.summary: The paper proposes a trust-aware coordination framework in which a shared knowledge graph serves as both centralized semantic memory and a coordination surface for multi-agent software pipelines, with calibrated confidence scores. It combines embedding-based retrieval with LLM multi-criteria analysis for traceability links and adds confidence-threshold gating, divergence detection, and conflict resolution, evaluated on an automotive case study.

items.title: LEDGER: Scaling Agentic Document Editing with Dependency-aware Graph Retrieval
items.title_zh: LEDGER：用依赖感知图检索扩展智能体文档编辑
items.summary: LEDGER builds a lightweight dependency graph over long structured documents, covering hierarchical organization, explicit references, implicit dependencies, and semantic relationships, and retrieves only the context each edit needs. On a 1.9k-case benchmark spanning six models it raises consistency from 56% to 76% while reducing token usage, and LEDGER at low reasoning effort matches baseline high-effort performance.

items.title: SafeClawBench: Separating Semantic, Audit-Evidence, and Sandbox Harm in Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.title_zh: SafeClawBench：区分工具调用型 LLM 智能体的语义、审计证据与沙箱危害
items.summary: SafeClawBench is a staged benchmark of 600 controlled adversarial tasks across six attack families, including direct and indirect prompt injection, tool-return injection, memory poisoning, and memory extraction, that scores semantic attack acceptance, audit-visible harm evidence, and sandbox-observed tool or state harm separately. Across five agent endpoints, semantic failure rates without extra prompt protection ranged from 9.0% to 44.2%, and a 12,000-row matched analysis found that 291 of 347 observed sandbox harms occurred in rows that passed the semantic check.

items.title: Learning What Not to Forget: Long-Horizon Agent Memory from a Few Kilobytes of Learning
items.title_zh: 学会不该忘记什么：仅需几千字节学习的长期智能体记忆
items.summary: LRE is a kilobyte-scale, CPU-only, language-model-free scorer that learns which units of interaction history are task-critical and keeps them by verbatim extraction rather than compression. Under a matched-budget comparison it recovers 93% of the accuracy of retaining full history (41.1 versus 44.0), cuts the worst-case peak prompt by 52%, and outranks dense and token-pruning encoders on conversational memory at zero neural cost while being 295–1569x smaller.

items.title: Consensus-based Agentic Large Language Model Framework for Harmonized Tariff Schedule Code Classification
items.title_zh: 面向协调关税表编码分类的共识式 Agentic LLM 框架
items.summary: The paper proposes an agentic LLM framework for Canadian 10-digit Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification that combines multi-agent information retrieval, semantic retrieval over official tariff documents, evidence-grounded reasoning, consensus validation, element-wise voting, confidence estimation, and human-in-the-loop escalation. On 3,300 expert-labeled product records, exact 10-digit classification remains difficult even for advanced LLMs, with performance degrading from chapter-level to fine-grained suffixes.

items.title: Verified Detection and Prevention of Concurrency Anomalies in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Systems
items.title_zh: 多 Agent 大语言模型系统中并发异常的验证检测与预防
items.summary: The paper models shared state in multi-agent LLM systems, including memory stores, vector indices, and tool registries, as long-running read-generate-write operations and formalizes four concurrency anomalies in TLA+. It machine-checks a consistency hierarchy, proves detectors sound and complete with 274 Verus obligations, and reproduces a silent lost update in ByteDance's deer-flow and tool-effect reordering in LangGraph's ToolNode.

items.title: EvolveNav: Proactive Preflection and Self-Evolving Memory for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation
items.title_zh: EvolveNav：面向零样本物体目标导航的主动预思与自演化记忆
items.summary: EvolveNav is a self-evolving framework for zero-shot object-goal navigation that extracts an agentic rule memory from past trajectories, retrieves rules with an upper-confidence-bound strategy balancing semantic relevance and historical success, and forecasts outcomes before acting. It reports a 10.1% improvement in success rate over zero-shot baselines with fewer unnecessary steps.

items.title: When Web Agents Finish but Still Fail: Reproducible Triggers and Trace Diagnostics for Parallel Web Exploration
items.title_zh: 当网页智能体“完成”却仍然失败：并行网页探索的可复现触发条件与轨迹诊断
items.summary: The authors introduce Parallel WebBench, a benchmark of 1,679 verified records for studying web agents that return well-formed answers yet still fail. The best GRPO model lifts completion over WebExplorer-8B from 50.7% to 96.0%, but binary accuracy remains far lower, and trace analysis identifies context-bound search loops, premature termination, and synthesis collapse.

items.title: FAPO: Fully Automated Prompt Optimization of Multi-Step LLM Pipelines
items.title_zh: FAPO：多步 LLM 流水线的全自动提示优化
items.summary: FAPO lets Claude Code optimize a multi-step LLM pipeline inside a standardized codebase by evaluating it, inspecting intermediate steps, diagnosing failures, and proposing scoped changes, starting with prompt edits and altering chain structure only when attribution identifies a structural bottleneck. It beats GEPA in 15 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons with a mean gain of 14.1 percentage points, and wins all six cases where prompt-first search escalated to structural changes, by 33.8 points on average.

items.title: Uncertainty Decomposition for Clarification Seeking in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 智能体澄清提问的不确定性分解
items.summary: The paper proposes a prompt-based decomposition that separates action confidence from request uncertainty, letting an agent ask for clarification when a task specification is ambiguous, using only signals available under black-box API and latency constraints. On two clarification-augmented benchmarks where half the tasks are deliberately underspecified, it improves clarification F1 on ALFWorld-Clarification by 73% over ReAct+UE and by 36% over Uncertainty-Aware Memory averaged across five backbones.

items.title: Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) for AI Assurance in Local Government
items.title_zh: GRAIDES：面向地方政府 AI 保障的生成式负责任 AI 数据评估模式
items.summary: GRAIDES is a lightweight open-source data model for centralizing AI observability across vendors, with blueprints for code, architecture, and statistical evaluation. A case study using Westminster City Council's AI catalogue focuses on measuring human-model alignment, including detecting systematic disagreement between evaluators.

items.title: Probe-and-Refine Tuning of Repository Guidance for Coding Agents
items.title_zh: 面向编码智能体的仓库指南探测-精炼调优
items.summary: The paper introduces probe-and-refine tuning, which uses synthetic bug-fix probes and single-shot LLM calls to iteratively diagnose and patch a repository's AGENTS.md-style guidance file, with no agent loop or tool use during tuning. On SWE-bench Verified across four trials with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at 200 steps, it reaches a 33.0% mean resolve rate versus 28.3% for the static knowledge base it started from and 25.5% unguided, with the gain coming from coverage rather than per-patch precision.

items.title: Dissecting Agentic RAG: A Component Ablation for Multi-Hop QA with a Local 7B Model
items.title_zh: 解构 Agentic RAG：本地 7B 模型多跳问答的组件消融
items.summary: The study ablates a full agentic RAG pipeline on 5,000 HotpotQA distractor questions with a local Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, where the full pipeline reaches EM 53.2% and F1 61.6% versus 43.1% and 54.0% for single-pass dense retrieval. Fixed hybrid retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion beats rule-based adaptive routing, and two retrieval iterations over decomposed sub-questions capture 95% of the gains of five.

items.title: CodeTeam: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Code Generation
items.title_zh: CodeTeam：面向仓库级代码生成的 LLM 多智能体框架
items.summary: CodeTeam separates natural-language-to-repository generation into planning, decision making, and implementation: multiple Architect agents draft competing design sketches, a CTO agent selects and normalizes one into a machine-checkable contract, and Developer agents build code under a dependency-aware scheduler with Git-based coordination while a QA agent drives repairs. On the SketchEval benchmark across 19 repositories under a retrieval-free protocol, its prompt-engineering variant improves the mean structural score by 3.84 points over CodeS (53.88 versus 50.04).

items.title: Revelio: Cost-Efficient Agentic Memory Safety Vulnerability Detection For Repository-Scale Codebases
items.title_zh: Revelio：面向仓库级代码库的低成本智能体内存安全漏洞检测
items.summary: Revelio combines inexpensive LLMs with lightweight static analysis to generate and rank vulnerability hypotheses, then confirms them with an executable proof-of-vulnerability checked by a sanitizer. Across seven long-fuzzed projects and 100 Arvo projects it found 19 previously unknown memory-safety bugs for about $300 and roughly one hour per project.

items.title: Context-Aware Distillation and Ablation for Text2DSL
items.title_zh: 面向Text2DSL的上下文感知蒸馏与消融
items.summary: Replaces prompt-only synthetic generation with context-aware distillation from DeepSeek-V4-Flash under a BNF grammar, API specification, and closed identifier vocabulary, growing a verified PolkitBench corpus to 10,073 pairs at 100.0% AST validity and a 99.7% runtime pass rate; ablations show structured context is load-bearing, with vocabulary contributing most to semantic quality.

items.title: VeriPort: Automated and Verified Patch Backporting at Scale
items.title_zh: VeriPort：大规模自动化且可验证的补丁回移
items.summary: Presents an end-to-end agentic system that backports a security patch to every affected package version and builds evidence that each backport blocks exploitation while preserving behavior; it resolved 95.3% of 128 BackportBench tasks, 22.7 points above Claude Code, and produced more than 5,000 verified patches across 169 high- and critical-severity CVEs.

items.title: GeoDisaster: Benchmarking Orchestrated Agents for Operational Disaster Geo-Intelligence
items.title_zh: GeoDisaster：面向业务化灾害地理智能的编排 Agent 基准
items.summary: GeoDisaster is a benchmark of 2,921 verified instances across 43 question types and five disaster-reasoning task families, integrating optical and SAR imagery, raster masks, vector geometries, road networks, and exposure layers with ground truth from executable geospatial workflows. The authors also propose an orchestrated multi-agent framework with 18 tools and a Role-Contract Expectation Alignment training scheme.

items.title: Capability Provenance in Language Models: A Case Study in Social Reasoning
items.title_zh: 语言模型中的能力溯源：社会推理案例研究
items.summary: Using gradient-based training-data attribution over the Dolma3 mix, the authors map which corpus regions support social versus STEM reasoning in OLMo3-7B and find that the two draw on qualitatively distinct regions, with the contrast sharper at the reasoning level than at the knowledge level. Targeted unlearning of high-attribution topics degrades the aligned benchmark more than within-topic random baselines, and the code and aggregate artifacts are released.

items.title: FlowEdit: Associative Memory for Lifelong Pronunciation Adaptation in Flow-Matching TTS
items.title_zh: FlowEdit：流匹配 TTS 中面向终身发音适应的联想记忆
items.summary: FlowEdit adapts frozen flow-matching TTS systems by learning pronunciation corrections as latent conditioning edits rather than weight updates, storing each correction in a Modern Hopfield Network used as content-addressable episodic memory. On a benchmark of 312 multilingual proper nouns across 18 language families, it reduces target-word phoneme error rate by 92.7% relative to the zero-shot baseline while keeping general-speech quality unchanged, with corrections completing in about 15 seconds on one GPU.

items.title: FeLoG: Scalable and Efficient Distributed Graph Embedding with Feedback Loop Mechanism
items.title_zh: FeLoG：带反馈环机制的可扩展高效分布式图嵌入
items.summary: FeLoG is a distributed graph-embedding system that couples sampling with real-time embedding-quality feedback to prioritize undertrained nodes, adds activity-aware communication compression, and overlaps next-round sampling with current-round training. Against six state-of-the-art baselines on large-scale graphs it reports an average 27.9x speedup, more than 53.1% lower communication cost, and over 80% CPU-GPU utilization, with graph-based retrieval-augmented generation among its target applications.

items.title: Only Ask What You Don't Know: Grounded Delta Planning for Efficient Multi-step RAG
items.title_zh: 只问未知：面向高效多步RAG的Grounded Delta规划
items.summary: Proposes Grounded Delta Planning RAG, which retrieves first to ground planning, prompts only for missing information, and pairs each subquery with a thought carrying evidence forward; it reports the highest accuracy among compared systems at 60.63% across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, at a cost-of-pass of 0.51, 22% below PAR-RAG and 68% below KnowTrace.

items.title: eneskirca/nodeterm
items.title_zh: eneskirca/nodeterm：AI 编码 Agent 的节点式终端管理器
items.summary: nodeterm is a node-based terminal manager for AI coding agents that presents tmux-backed terminals and parallel agent sessions as draggable nodes on an infinite pan-and-zoom canvas, with macOS, Linux, and browser editions.

items.title: LING71671/open-reverselab
items.title_zh: open-reverselab：开源 AI 逆向工程智能体平台
items.summary: open-reverselab is an open-source Python platform and MCP server for Ghidra, Frida, x64dbg, and Rizin that automates PE, APK, and binary analysis for CTF and malware research. It ships more than 100 MCP tools and a 194-article runnable knowledge base.

items.title: LilMGenius/paperthin
items.title_zh: paperthin：底层智能体设计模式
items.summary: Paperthin is a JavaScript collection of low-level agentic design patterns intended to turn established engineering wisdom into reflexes that an agent applies on its own.

items.title: ray-r-ren/agent-apprenticeship
items.title_zh: agent-apprenticeship：AI 智能体的工作流学徒生态
items.summary: Agent Apprenticeship describes an ecosystem in which AI agents complete tasks in workflow loops, improve through iterative execution, and are evaluated by mentor agents or humans, turning finished work into reusable experience and data.

items.title: L20-Edu-135M: An Auditable Single-GPU Study of Data-Efficient Small Language Modeling
items.title_zh: L20-Edu-135M：单 GPU 数据高效小语言建模的可审计研究
items.summary: L20-Edu-135M is a 134.5M-parameter language model trained end-to-end on a single NVIDIA L20 GPU on roughly 13B tokens, with documented data gates, near-deduplication, benchmark-overlap removal, supervised fine-tuning with weight interpolation, and RLVR on GSM8K. It trails SmolLM-135M on a self-run six-task harness (mean 0.4150 versus 0.4767) while using 2.17% of its nominal token count, and direct GRPO-style RLVR decreased GSM8K exact-match accuracy in the reported single runs.

items.title: moBERTo: A Modern Encoder for Portuguese via Continued Pretraining of ModernBERT
items.title_zh: moBERTo：通过ModernBERT继续预训练构建的葡萄牙语现代编码器
items.summary: Adapts ModernBERT to Portuguese through continued pretraining on 60 billion tokens while keeping the original architecture; the best variant posted the highest average reranking nDCG@10 across three Portuguese retrieval benchmarks and the best PLUE-PT results, with weights and training data released on Hugging Face.

items.title: Jun 15, 2026 Product Engineering Building a Better LiteParse Skill with Evals Read
items.title_zh: 用评估构建更好的 LiteParse 技能
items.summary: LlamaIndex published a product-engineering post on building a better LiteParse skill with evaluations.

items.title: Predicting model behavior before release by simulating deployment
items.title_zh: 通过部署模拟在发布前预测模型行为
items.summary: OpenAI describes Deployment Simulation, a method that uses real conversation data to predict how a model will behave after deployment, with the stated aim of improving safety and the accuracy of evaluations.

items.title: Running local models is good now
items.title_zh: 现在跑本地模型已经很好用了
items.summary: The author argues that local agentic coding has improved notably over the past few months.

items.title: Securing the future of AI agents
items.title_zh: 守护 AI 智能体的未来
items.summary: Google DeepMind outlines an AI Control Roadmap for securing internal systems by combining traditional safeguards with real-time monitoring.

items.title: Introducing LifeSciBench
items.title_zh: 推出 LifeSciBench
items.summary: OpenAI introduces LifeSciBench, an expert-authored and expert-reviewed benchmark for evaluating how AI systems handle real-world life science research tasks and decisions.

items.title: Improving health intelligence in ChatGPT
items.title_zh: 提升 ChatGPT 的健康智能
items.summary: OpenAI describes how GPT-5.5 Instant improves ChatGPT's health and wellness responses through stronger reasoning, better context, clearer communication, and physician-informed evaluations.

items.title: Jun 18, 2026 Product Markdown Comes to LiteParse Read
items.title_zh: LiteParse Read 支持 Markdown
items.summary: LlamaIndex announced that Markdown output is now available in LiteParse Read; the supplied excerpt provides no further technical detail.

items.title: Using AI to help physicians diagnose rare genetic diseases affecting children
items.title_zh: 用 AI 帮助医生诊断影响儿童的罕见遗传病
items.summary: Researchers used an OpenAI reasoning model to help diagnose rare diseases, identifying 18 new diagnoses in previously unsolved cases.

items.title: Building reliable agentic AI systems
items.title_zh: 构建可靠的智能体AI系统
items.summary: A Martin Fowler article on building reliable agentic AI systems, using the case of AI that helps pharmaceutical researchers query decades of information buried in PDF reports.

items.title: Xiaomi releases MiMo Claw AI agent, raises free access to four hours daily
items.title_zh: 小米发布 MiMo Claw AI 智能体，每日免费时长提升至四小时
items.summary: Xiaomi's large model team launched MiMo Claw, a lightweight cloud-based AI agent powered by its flagship MiMo-V2.5-Pro model, and raised free access to four hours per day.

items.title: Temporary Cloudflare accounts for AI agents
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 为 AI Agent 推出临时账户
items.summary: Cloudflare is rolling out Temporary Accounts on Workers, letting any agent deploy a live Worker in seconds rather than hitting account-creation walls built for humans.
